verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 documents a create-a-webhook endpoint. It lets a programmatic consumer register a `subscriberUrl`, choose event triggers (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_PAYMENT_INITIATED, BOOKING_PAID, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_REQUESTED, BOOKING_CANCELLED) and customize the payload template, with OAuth scope requirements documented. These are genuine registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: documentation of delivery guarantees (signing secrets, retries), webhook scopes beyond event types, independent or hands-on corroboration.
